//: Which preview scene draws each look and variant (README.md), and the art it takes from templates/looks/. scene: 3d or 2d. models: a directory whose models replace the 3D scene's of the same name (the look's authored models). sprites: 3D beats stood in the set as pixel sprites, by beat: the file under art and its height in metres. art: the art directory. For the 2D scene (2d/stage.ts): plan: side or top, the same place from the side or from above; unit: the look's logical pixels a metre (none without a pixel grid); view: the view's height in metres; size: the frame drawn, a whole multiple of the look's grid; light: day (the default: white ambient, the lanterns warm what they reach), night (a dim ambient, the lanterns light the scene) or none (a look whose few tones a light would break); haze: the tree line's opacity; text and rim: the HUD count's colour and its rim's as #rrggbb (white on near black unless the look's contract names its text's colours); heights: each beat's height in metres (its width from the image); widths: the beats sized by their width instead. A look or variant not listed draws the 3D scene with its own models.
